title: Finalizer cross-check trusts the stamp's `passed` alone, ignoring the stamp's own `violation_count` — a contradictory clean verdict can ship flagged prose
evidence:
final_compliance_remediation.py:278: `        if verdict is not None and verdict.get("passed") is True:`
compliance_enforcement.py:364: `        violation_count=len(review.violations),`
agent.py:680: `            if review is not None and review.passed and not review.violations:`
detail: The gate's own clean test requires `passed and not violations`, but the cross-check proceeds on `passed=True` alone. The stamp records `violation_count` (compliance_enforcement.py:352/364) and it is never consulted. A schema-legal contradictory judge output (passed=true with violations) plus a #172-class slot-propagation failure ships prose the judge flagged. The final gate is the last gate — no backstop.
recommended_fix: In both finalize guards require `verdict.get("passed") is True and verdict.get("violation_count", 0) == 0 and verdict.get("parseable") is True`, mirroring the gate's `passed and not violations` clean test.

title: Cross-check is one-sided: a stale DIRTY review left in the slot by an earlier attempt beats a CLEAN stamp — the clean-verdict fail-close (issue #172 symptom) survives the deeper propagation failure
location: tenant_scorer/agent.py:668-676 (loop seeds only judge meta, never clears the review slot) + tenant_scorer/callbacks/final_compliance_remediation.py:270-272
evidence:
agent.py:668: `            ctx.session.state[STATE_COMPLIANCE_JUDGE_META] = {`
final_compliance_remediation.py:270: `    raw = state.get(STATE_FINAL_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW)`
final_compliance_remediation.py:271: `    review = ComplianceReviewResult.coerce(raw)`
final_compliance_remediation.py:272: `    if review is None:`
detail: The cross-check fires only when the slot reads None. The slot is never cleared between attempts, so if attempt N-1's DIRTY review propagated and attempt N's CLEAN write fails to propagate, finalize sees the stale dirty review, fail-closes, and the clean stamp is never consulted — the exact #172 symptom persists in the failure world the cross-check was built for.
recommended_fix: Clear the review slot before each judge run (or compare stamp `attempt` against the slot's, rescuing when the stamp is newer and clean), so a clean stamp also overrides a stale dirty slot.
